text_block_list.text:
Here it is, the "Shuka Sho"! And yet, 
Trainer, you're looking rather anxious, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At times like this, you simply must listen 
to my Tiara-exclusive live song, "Irodori 
Phantasia"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we are just like a princess and a... 
prince! I shall punish our foes with my 
Princess☆Cross Armbreaker~~!!
